title: JBT Marel now offers value-added end-to-end meat preparation and portioning lines
summary: Whether you're producing marinated diced products, value-added proteins, or precision-portioned fresh meat, our complete line solutions cover every step from raw material preparation to final pack.
body_markdown:
##### Case packing


Our Proseal[Case Packer](https://jbtmarel.com/en/products/case-packing-machinery/) automates the transfer of packs into cases using high-speed 2D delta robotics. It supports multiple case formats while maintaining product quality and throughput. Quick-release tooling enables fast changeovers, while the ProMotion™ system ensures smooth and continuous operation.


Dirk sums up the line: “Each piece of equipment performs its role exceptionally well while integrating seamlessly into one complete line—from crust freezing and precise portioning to controlled weight management and a finished case ready product.”


##### One partner from concept to full production


Building a full-line solution means understanding your process, your products, your people, your facility, and your production goals. Our teams work closely with you throughout the entire process, from early evaluation and line integration to installation, commissioning, and ongoing service support.


That means one supplier, one connected solution, and one JBT Marel Service partner dedicated to delivering lifetime performance. You benefit from practical guidance, responsive support, and deep application expertise built on decades of industry experience.


##### See these solutions in action


Experience these connected meat preparation and portioning solutions firsthand at[Meat ShowHow 2026](https://jbtmarel.com/en/events/meat-showhow-2026-flexibility-to-optimize-value/) , taking place on 6 October 2026 at the JBT Marel Progress Point in Copenhagen, Denmark. The event brings together meat processors from around the world to explore the latest innovations in meat processing through live demonstrations, expert insights, and real-world production scenarios.


From value-added meat preparation and marination to precision portioning, packaging, and automation, you'll see how integrated production lines can help maximize value, improve flexibility, and drive operational efficiency across the entire meat value chain.


##### Ready to explore what’s possible?


Whether you are planning your next production line or simply exploring future opportunities, our experts are ready to help. Learn more about Meat ShowHow or book a meeting to discuss your goals, ask questions, and discover how a complete JBT Marel fresh meat portioning line can transform your production.
